create.name: Ramakrishna Math and Ramakrishna Mission (Belur Math)
create.bio:
Belur Math is the headquarters of the Ramakrishna Math and the Ramakrishna Mission, twin monastic and service bodies that grew from the life of the Bengali saint Sri Ramakrishna and were set up by his foremost disciple, Swami Vivekananda. Their teaching rests on Vedanta as Vivekananda presented it: the divinity latent in every person, work offered as worship and respect for all faiths as genuine paths. The order does not seek converts. The campus covers about forty acres on the west bank of the Hooghly at Belur, in Howrah district, with temples to Sri Ramakrishna, Sri Sarada Devi and Swami Brahmananda, and runs a large network of branch centres in India and abroad alongside schools, hospitals and relief work.

Its YouTube channel, active since 2013, is the headquarters' own record of monastic life. Alongside short darshan films of the temples and live coverage of the great festivals such as Durga Puja and Kali Puja, it carries long talks by senior monks, mostly in Bengali, on spiritual life, the guru, the Ramakrishna tradition and the lives of earlier swamis of the order, recorded at devotees' conventions and memorial lectures.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube 345,000 subscribers (YouTube Data API, 10 Nov 2026); no other counts read → ~345k → luminary
flags: Email mail@rkmm.org is the General Secretary's correspondence inbox, shown in the footer of belurmath.org (an organisational inbox).
belurmath.org's robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 600; only the home page and the About page were read (the second request came about 7 minutes after the first, short of the 10-minute delay).
Only one photo: the order's emblem (channel avatar). Temple photos on the site are hosted on Flickr and were not checked.
Video titles are Bengali, kept as published; the channel is mostly festival coverage and short darshan clips, so only recorded talks were chosen.

Branches already on Spiritpedia: Vedanta Society of Southern California and Vedanta Society of New York (Ramakrishna Order centres); Swami Sarvapriyananda belongs to the order but the pages read don't name him, so the teachers file is empty.
No offerings: the headquarters doesn't sell courses or retreats; guest-house stays are by email only.
Item count: 10 videos and 2 free resources; no paid items.
left_out: Puja livestreams, darshan clips, inaugurations, a government 'drug-free youth' pledge clip (health/political) and cultural performances.
Books: the order's publications were not checked for ISBNs.
sprint.held: Held by Claude (10 Nov 2026): belurmath.org asks for Crawl-delay 600, so the ingest's image check never finished (dry run stopped after 36 minutes); only one image (the emblem). Owner to decide: insert with a YouTube-avatar photo instead, or leave out.
